765040102.text: Ineffa? What're you doing up here on the roof? Are you... observing cloud shapes to calculate the probability of rain... or something?

765040103.text: I am performing a task that is experiencing an... unexpected deviation.

765040104.text: The original plan was to purchase a "high-precision gear" and "special hexagonal screw" as stipulated in Aino's list.

765040105.text: However, I encountered an... unforeseeable supply interdiction incident during the return trip. A falcon, flying at high speed, snatched the specially-made screw from my hands.

765040106.text: So you came up to the roof to look for that falcon?

765040107.text: Affirmative. This species' habits indicate a propensity to use rooftops as temporary stopping points. Response: Comprehensive visual and audio scan. Objective: locate the target.

765040108.text: However, I have not found any traces of my target thus far. Initial deduction: Target has escaped detection radius, or may have brought its "prize" to a more secluded nest.

765040109.text: Commencing backup plan: Return to designated supplier and purchase a new screw of the same model.

765040110.text: Anyway. Are you two also here in pursuit of some small animal?

765040113.text: Yeah. We originally wanted to find a spot with a good view so we could snag some panoramic shots of Nasha Town in all its hustling, bustling glory!

765040114.text: We didn't expect to run into you while you were on the hunt for a "thief." Guess that's a super-rare "unexpected deviation" too, huh?

765040401.text: Have you considered how the photo shall be taken? I am standing by to assist you.

765040501.text: We're good. Let the photo-op begin!

765040601.text: One moment. The inspiration's not quite coming yet...

765040701.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Have you eaten? Do you have any special plans today?

765040704.text: Understood. Walking around and capturing what you see in the frame is a reasonable way to relax.

765040705.text: However, I do not detect a Kamera on your person. Did you leave it somewhere in your hurry to leave home?

765040801.text: Have you found suitable photo-taking material? Haste is unnecessary. The good things in life are worth uncovering patiently.

765040804.text: Understood. However, I do not detect a Kamera on your person. Did you leave it somewhere in your hurry to leave home?
